    SELECT d.ancestor_id,

           d.ancestor_color,
           c.product_id,
           c.product_name,
           c.product_color
    FROM descendants d
    JOIN Products c ON c.parent_product_id = d.descendant_id
)
SELECT ancestor_id   AS ancestor_product_id,
